usage: deskops repo whoami [-h] [--root ROOT] [--store STORE] [--set IDENTITY]

Print the canonical project identity for the current repository.

options:
  -h, --help      show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT     Repository root to identify
  --store STORE   Store path to anchor the registry lookup
  --set IDENTITY  Rewrite project_identity in desk/config.json (a slug)
